description:
# Niconico YT Integration Test 1.49.0-niconico.5

Personal test distribution of the maintainer's current code in
[MorpheApp/morphe-patches PR #4080](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/4080),
locked to commit **81d8b03d6c22af1a0bfc30f2f78c1608827d7ee9**.

The feature implementation and resources match that snapshot. Only distribution
branding, version, documentation, generated listing, source metadata, and excluded
GitHub Actions workflows differ. This is not an official Morphe release.

## Changes from the previous personal test
- Includes the maintainer's refactoring and native settings/player control integration.
- The patch is now named **Niconico comments** and is included in the recommended selection.
- The feature itself defaults to OFF. Enable it in YouTube's Morphe settings and restart the app before testing.
- Replaces the old text button with the new comments icons, including legacy player controls.
- Adds travel duration and maximum comment length settings alongside font size and opacity.
- Includes the maintainer's high-frame-rate scrolling change and updated source attribution.
- Uses the maintainer's full official YouTube target declaration. This does not establish device compatibility for every target.

## 폰에서 테스트
1. 기존 주소 `https://github.com/david419kr/morphe-patches`는 그대로 사용합니다.
2. **Sources → Niconico YT Integration Test → Update**에서 **1.49.0-niconico.5**를 확인합니다.
3. 다른 공식/독립 니코니코 소스는 비활성화하고, 원본 **YouTube 21.23.492 APK**에 권장 패치를 적용합니다. **Niconico comments**가 선택됐는지 확인합니다.
4. 설치 후 **YouTube의 Morphe 설정 → Player → Niconico comments**에서 기능을 켜고 앱을 재시작합니다. 패치 기본 포함과 댓글 기능 ON은 별개입니다.
5. 플레이어의 새 댓글 아이콘으로 표시를 켜고 끕니다. 길게 누르면 글꼴 크기·불투명도·이동 시간·최대 댓글 길이를 바꿀 수 있습니다.
6. 공개 라이브, 다시보기/프리미어 채팅, 탐색·배속·일시정지·재개, 가로·세로 전환, 네 가지 슬라이더를 확인해 주세요.

This exact PR snapshot has not yet been verified on the user's phone. No OK reply,
approval, or merge request has been sent to the maintainer. The standalone 1.3.3
source remains separate and unchanged.

## Local validation
- 160 unit tests passed, including 28 Niconico tests; five existing Music tests requiring an external APK fixture were skipped.
- Verified 108,508 resource strings with no issues.
- Android MPP packaging succeeded and the final bundle contains classes.dex.
- The final bundle applied all 107 selected patches, including Niconico comments, to the original Google-signed YouTube 21.23.492 APK. APK rebuilding succeeded with zero failed patches and no force override.
- Source and resource trees match PR revision 81d8b03d6c22af1a0bfc30f2f78c1608827d7ee9. The personal distribution branch retains manual releases and no GitHub Actions workflows.
- These are local build/patch checks, not device playback verification of the new maintainer code.
